The '''IR-9X Replicator Droid''' was a model of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]], a freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. IR-9X Replicators were capable of generating sophisticated [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] over their frames, allowing for highly-effective disguises, and a number of them were stored at the Shroud's factory on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
IR-9X Replicator Droids appear as enemies in the final [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] mission&mdash;"The Shroud Revealed" for Republic players and "All the Pieces" for Imperials&mdash; in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Replicator Droids will adopt the appearances of major characters from the participating players' class stories.<ref name="TOR" />
